scope: TransformerSmall, clean elastic world, seed 0; full 52000 training and 13000 test rows. Five-seed linear probes across all five worlds.
finding: The original feature representation learns a weak price response. Training from 12 to 36 epochs leaves all actions at the upper boundary. Training-period item-relative log price restores a much steeper response and materially lowers regret with the original 12-epoch budget.
boundary: One neural seed and one world; does not establish a unique cause, final corrected ranking, or results for Large. The relative-price diagnostic relates to deferred P0; no formal preprocessing change applied.
next_step: Keep current results as original-pipeline evidence; validate matched feature representation across seeds and models before replacing aggregate comparisons.
